name: jp-office
description: Japanese office toolkit — Excel/CSV workbench (encoding/normalization/diff/pivot/chart), Japanese business documents (議事録/稟議書/敬語メール/スライド構成/翻訳), date utilities (祝日/営業日/和暦), plus /xl-clean /xl-diff /xl-pivot /xl-chart /giji /ringi /keigo /jp-office-setup commands.
